title: Toilet Paper Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass Freestanding Euro Style | Unlacquered Brass | Best Sellers Collection | Allied Brass
description:
When wall space is tight, keep toilet paper within reach with a freestanding toilet paper stand in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. This floor stand works as a toilet paper holder (also called a toilet tissue stand or toilet roll holder) placed right beside the toilet, and the European-style hook makes roll changes quick and easy.

Highlights:
- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Faster roll changes: European-style hook for quick replacement
- Coordinate a cohesive look: Best Sellers Collection styling pairs well with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Durable construction: crafted from solid brass (brass construction) with multiple designer finish options available

Specs & Details:
- Type: freestanding toilet paper stand / toilet tissue stand / toilet paper holder
- Material: solid brass
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6.75 in x 26 in x 5.5 in
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 9 in x 9 in x 29 in
- Shipping weight: 6 lb
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Assembly: Assembled in the USA
